rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose term for skating on ice, whether describing the activity or the sport.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 lau6 bing1

rows.note: Use this when the skating is specifically roller skating on land rather than ice skating.

example.english: After school, my friends and I go roller skating in the park.
example.traditional: 放學後我同朋友去公園滾軸溜冰。
